rubric.role_summary: Senior/Staff full-stack engineer building customer-facing product features across the UI, API, and backend, with work on real-time collaboration, synchronization, and performance.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior/Staff full-stack engineer building customer-facing product features across the UI, API, and backend, with work on real-time collaboration, synchronization, and performance.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience building customer-facing products.
- Strong JavaScript fundamentals and a background working with React and TypeScript.
- Experience across the full stack; the parenthetical technologies are examples, not an all-technologies requirement.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Track record of driving complex, end-to-end features, rather than only incremental improvements or refactors, with visible product impact.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: North America or Europe (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in one of these places. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
